title: Add PRODUCED item template to Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data
summary: Manufacturing demo data now includes a PRODUCED item template with manufacturing-specific settings like replenishment system, manufacturing policy, and flushing method pre-configured for created items.
key_points: New PRODUCED item template added to Manufacturing module with manufacturing-specific field values
New codeunit 5310 creates the template with insert-if-not-exists logic for idempotency
Extended Contoso Inventory.InsertItemTemplateData with manufacturing-capable overload that sets planning fields
Template includes standard manufacturing settings like Prod. Order replenishment, Make-to-Order policy, and Manual flushing
Existing thin overload and callers remain untouched to avoid side effects
